title: HostEventGroupProgressViewDocument
description: Server-owned manager projection of one configured group of a live event (event:whole and each pace group) for the live console's departure sheet, written ahead of time by triggers on the event, its event success plan and the group's progress row. view is what the retired getEventAssistanceGroupProgress callable returned for a manager, without serverTime: eventOpen is computed as if the current time were one millisecond before the event ends, so the phone ANDs it (and the guidance it gates) with the app clock before eventEndAtMillis. The actor-specific parts of the old response are constants for a manager on the phone (departure authority canConfirm with anyAuthorizedOperator and no expiry). Written for every event that has an eventFormat and an endTime; views of groups that leave the route plan, and of events that are deleted or lose either field, are deleted. A source row that fails validation records sourceCoverage invalidSource with incompleteSource and keeps the previous view. Managers read it under rules; only managers use the live console's reads.
x-owner: Live movement view evaluator (hostReadModels movement view triggers)

progressId.description: progressIdentity(context, groupId), the id of the group's eventAssistanceGroupProgress row.

organizerId.description: The event's organizer; rules key on it.

revision.description: Increases by one with every committed evaluation that changed the document.

evaluatedAt.description: When the last changing evaluation committed. The phone treats it as a lower bound for the current time.

sourceCoverage.description: Whether the last evaluation read every source validly. invalidSource keeps the previous view.

incompleteSource.description: The collection whose document failed validation (events, eventSuccessPlans or eventAssistanceGroupProgress), or null when coverage is complete.

eventEndAtMillis.description: The event's end. The phone sets eventOpen false and guidance null once the app clock reaches it.

eventOpen.description: Computed one millisecond before the event ends; the phone ANDs it with the app clock.

view.description: The manager projection; null only when the first evaluation was already invalid.
